title: Bridge Buddies
desc: Build and test twenty bridges with unlimited free supports, improving their strength to safely carry each load.
mission: Build four strong bridge spans with unlimited materials. Test each span's vehicle load, replace weak supports, and help twenty cargo trucks cross through four builder ranks.
take: Choose the right support for the job. Test a small model, notice what happened, and change one thing at a time.

title: Water Works
desc: Turn the pipes through twenty advancing flow puzzles and bring water through the toy filter to town.
mission: Rotate each pipe network from the reservoir to town. Pass through the toy filter while advancing from Flow Finder to Waterworks Master.
take: Trace a problem from its starting point and check each connection. This toy filter does not make real water safe to drink.

title: Harbor Helpers
desc: Load your boat for twenty advancing island deliveries and bring each community exactly what it requested.
mission: Read each island request, choose the matching crates, stay within the boat limit, and advance through twenty harbor routes.
take: A useful delivery starts with listening. Plan loads and routes together so supplies reach the neighbors who asked for them.

title: Pantry Picnic
desc: Solve eight colorful picnic challenges from a rotating bank of twenty-four pantry plans.
mission: Pack eight pretend picnic boxes, each with one main and two produce portions. Follow each request, use marked leftovers first, and meet all twenty-four challenges before they repeat.
take: Check what you already have before getting more. Planning portions can reduce waste; ask an adult about allergies, food preparation, and safe storage.

title: Compass Cove
desc: Explore a tiny island through twenty advancing compass clues and hidden treasures.
mission: Find twenty treasures by following clues from island landmarks. Advance from Shore Scout to Master Navigator while north stays up on the map.
take: Start from a landmark you can identify. A map and a compass help you explain a route and check where a direction will take you.

title: Cipher Club
skill: Make meaning with a shared key
desc: Turn the code wheel and solve twenty messages that grow from three to five letters.
mission: Use the toy A–H alphabet and a shared number key to encode or decode twenty clubhouse messages. Advance through four code ranks as the words grow longer.
take: A shared rule can change how a message looks. This tiny code is easy to break and must never be used to protect passwords or real secrets.

title: Trade Town
desc: Visit the market for eight shopping challenges and compare bundles, prices, and extra fees.
mission: Fill eight shopping requests within their pretend budgets. Compare bundle sizes, unit prices, and delivery fees. You can return items before checkout.
take: The biggest pack is not always the best fit. Compare the whole cost, including fees, with how much you actually need.

title: Critter Council
desc: Listen to eighty neighbor requests while building twenty welcoming woodland neighborhoods.
mission: Advance through twenty town-planning levels. Place a shaded park, quiet reading hut, step-free ramp, and bench so every set of four neighbor requests is met.
take: People can need different things from the same place. Ask, listen, and design so more neighbors can take part comfortably.

title: Traffic Town
skill: Read traffic signs & choose safe actions
desc: Cruise through a friendly practice town and learn sixty common road signs through dimensional sign models.
mission: Practice ten different traffic-sign challenges each round from a sixty-sign bank. Six rounds rotate without repeats while you name the sign, notice its shape or color, and choose the safest meaning or action.
take: Traffic Town teaches common U.S. sign patterns for early road awareness. Real driving requires the official rules where you live, adult supervision, and age-appropriate licensing.

title: Street Safety Scout
desc: Spot signal lights, caution and emergency signs, vehicle lights, roadside warnings, and hidden street hazards.
mission: Complete fifteen visual safety stops per route, balanced across five safety categories. Practice all sixty distinct scenarios across four no-repeat routes.
take: Notice the clue first, then choose a calm, predictable action. Always follow current local signs, officials, emergency directions, and the rules where you live.

title: Pocket Planet
desc: Grow gardens, build useful creations and prepare foods in thirty real-world-inspired practice projects.
mission: Complete ten supply-and-making projects per round. Choose three useful materials or foods, then put three steps in the correct order. Three rounds cover all thirty projects without coins or purchases.
take: Choose useful supplies, prepare safely with an adult when needed, and learn the order of steps for growing, building and cooking.

title: Scam Sleuth
desc: Investigate sneaky messages and protect your digital clubhouse.
mission: Try six different clubhouse messages each round from a bank of twenty. Choose whether to read, check another way, or block and tell a trusted adult.
take: Slow down when a message asks for secrets, money, or a rushed decision. Check through a route you already trust.

title: Kindness Quest
desc: Help the treehouse crew listen, work together, and set kind boundaries.
mission: The treehouse crew needs your help. Try six different choices each round from a bank of twenty that make room for everyone, including you.
take: You can care about someone and still say no. Ask, listen, and make a plan together.

title: Fact Finder
desc: Run a tiny news desk. Sort evidence, opinions, ads, and unchecked claims.
mission: Try six different news-desk cards each round from a bank of twenty. Sort each into evidence, opinion, advertisement, or needs checking.
take: A popular claim is not automatically a fact. Look for a source, context, and something you can check.

title: Repair Café
desc: Practice repair-and-care skills with a bank of twenty different challenges before replacing something.
mission: Try eight repair situations per round from a bank of twenty. Put the steps in a sensible order: inspect first, choose a safe fix, make the small repair, then test it.
take: Looking closely can save time, materials, and money. Small repairs can give things a second life.

title: Time Trail
desc: Explore sixty progressively longer trails over six chapters, from easy 5×5 paths to giant 7×7 summits.
mission: Explore sixty map levels in six chapters. Collect three, four, or five flags, plan around new rock patterns, and follow your saved checkpoint from one session to the next.
take: Plan the whole route before the first step. If a route does not work, reset and try a different one.

title: Garden Guardians
desc: Grow eight different gardens, balance crops and pollinator flowers, and protect your water supply.
mission: Advance through eight garden levels and four ranks. Match each planting plan, water wisely across three days, and earn up to three stars per garden.
take: Different plants support different needs. Sharing limited water takes planning.

title: Energy Island
desc: Power eight different islands through changing forecasts, higher demand, and long nights.
mission: Advance through eight energy-island levels and four ranks. Use limited builder tokens, read four-day forecasts, balance solar, wind, and batteries, and earn stars for reliable power.
take: Sources change with conditions. Storing a surplus can help when production drops.

title: Reuse Rally
desc: Clean up Toy Town. Reuse what you can and sort the rest.
mission: Sort six different objects each round from a bank of twenty: reuse, recycling, compost, or trash. Real local rules can differ.
take: Using something again can avoid waste. Check your local recycling and compost rules with an adult.

title: Robot Rover
desc: Code a little rover through twenty progressive star-filled worlds and four explorer ranks.
mission: Build a command list with forward, turn left, and turn right. Watch Rover's facing direction, test your path, and improve it for efficiency stars.
take: Debugging means noticing what happened and improving one part of your plan. Mistakes are clues.

title: Lemonade Lab
desc: Run a tiny stand. Try a price, watch the weather, and learn from your ledger.
mission: Run your stand for four days. Choose how many cups to make and a price. Supplies cost 1 coin per cup.
take: Revenue is the money that comes in. Profit is what remains after costs. Leftovers and demand matter, too.

title: Beat Builder
desc: Make a beat, try a rhythm challenge, and invent your own sound.
mission: Use the 16-step beat grid. Make a steady kick, an offbeat clap, and a repeating hi-hat. Sound is optional.
take: A repeating pattern creates rhythm. Small changes can make a familiar pattern feel new.

title: KidsCoin Family App
desc: Plan family tasks, practice saving, and choose rewards together.

title: Brain Sweat Expanded
desc: Try coding, shop skills, gardening, and everyday problem-solving challenges.

title: Brain Sweat Life Skills
desc: Explore practical lessons about food, your home, nature, and feelings.

title: Bubble Resonance Φ369
desc: Aim glossy round bubbles through twenty named matching levels with bank shots, number clues, and three field-clearing powers.

title: Chill Brain Rewards
desc: Meet your guide and take a gentle pause with breathing and focus games.

title: Creature Catcher
desc: Catch curious creatures, answer questions, and fill your field guide.

title: Road Trip Quest
desc: Collect power-ups, meet heroes, and solve challenges across eight cities.

title: Road Trip Quest GPS
desc: Explore a pretend neighborhood, discover places, and collect discoveries.

title: Weather Watchers
skill: Read the sky & a simple forecast
desc: Look closely at realistic sky scenes, name the weather, read forecast clues, and choose a safe plan.
mission: Advance through four levels and all twenty-five picture challenges about sky clues, clouds, weather preparation, and forecasts.
take: The sky gives clues, not promises. Check a current local forecast with a trusted adult and follow real weather alerts.

title: Garden Grow & Harvest
skill: Build, grow, harvest & keep food fresh
desc: Choose the right picture to build a garden, plant seeds, care for crops, harvest produce, and keep it fresh.
mission: Advance through four levels and all twenty-four picture challenges from building the bed through safe food storage.
take: Read the seed packet, work with a trusted adult, use tools safely, and wash garden food before eating it.
